name: ninjaone
label: NinjaOne
description: NinjaOne (formerly NinjaRMM) is a unified endpoint management, patching, and ticketing platform. This connector inventories devices and installed software, reads and applies operating system and third-party patches, runs automation scripts, controls Windows services, reboots and schedules maintenance on endpoints, manages alerts and tickets, and ingests pending patches as findings so playbooks can drive remediation end to end.

fields.title: Region
fields.name: region
fields.tooltip: NinjaOne region. Must match where the API client app was created.
fields.description: NinjaOne instance your tenant lives in. NinjaOne is region-isolated: an API client created in one region does not exist in any other, and the token endpoint reports that as "Client app not exist" rather than an authentication error. Match this to the hostname you log in to.

fields.title: Client ID
fields.name: client_id

fields.description: Client ID of the API application, from Administration > Apps > API > Client App IDs. The application platform must be "API Services (machine-to-machine)".

fields.title: Client Secret
fields.name: client_secret

fields.description: Client secret issued with the Client ID. Shown once at creation.

fields.title: Scope
fields.name: scope
fields.tooltip: Space-separated OAuth scopes. Must be a subset of what the app is granted.
fields.description: Space-separated OAuth scopes to request. "monitoring" covers reads, "management" covers writes, and "control" is required for script execution and reboots. The app must already be granted each scope requested here.

fields.title: Custom Server URL
fields.name: server_url

fields.description: Overrides the Region above. Only needed for a non-standard endpoint; leave blank otherwise.
